prompt: What is true of both routes when they are offered?
promptZh: 兩條路線在都有開放時，有什麼共同點？

options.whyZh: 短線留在運河的原側，沒有過橋。

options.text: They both pass the artist’s studio.
options.zh: 兩條都會經過藝術家的工作室。
options.whyZh: 只有長線會在工作室停留。

options.text: They both start with the theater projection.
options.zh: 兩條都以劇院牆上的投影開始。
options.whyZh: 原文直接說兩條線一開始都看劇院牆投影。

options.text: They both enter the last sculpture area by the ramp.
options.zh: 兩條都從坡道進入最後一座雕塑的區域。
options.whyZh: 坡道是短線路段；文中不曾說長線也走坡道。

explanationZh: 原文直接說兩條線一開始都看劇院牆投影。
evidence: Both routes include the projection on the theater wall at the start.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Both routes include the projection on the theater wall at the start.

vocabulary.note: 這裡指把影像投到劇院牆上。
